supporting_pages.title: Pricing plans for Google Cloud Marketplace products \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: You're charged software usage fees for your Kubernetes containers, and for the GKE infrastructure that you use.
Cloud Marketplace links usage fees to an automatically-created Google Cloud project whose ID begins with pr , followed by a series of unique letters and numbers.
For example, some vendors might charge by the number of containers that you run the app on and the number of API requests you make to the app.
